faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Child Development Project Office, Diu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026, and candidates report at 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Child Development Project Office, Diu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Creche Worker, 2 Creche Helper.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Child Development Project Office, Diu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 3:00 PM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: CDPO Office, Sewa Bhavan, Collectorate office Diu.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹ 5,500 per month (Honorarium) for Creche Worker, ₹ 3,000 per month (Honorarium) for Creche Helper.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 12th pass (H.S.C. passed certificate from a recognized board); local village female candidates only. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only local village female candidates may apply. Applicant should be a resident of the area mentioned for the post. Domicile of Daman & Diu gets weightage as per O. M. No. 1-187-CS/PF/2823 dated 16-12-2013, on producing Domicile Certificate from the Mamlatdar.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Walk-in interview at CDPO Office, Diu. Daman & Diu domicile holders given weightage.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on honorarium basis. No right or claim for regularization against regular vacancies. Waiting list valid for 1 year.
